the identical path with fused qm31_cm31_dot4 in optimized mode; the paired delta isolates the arithmetic-kernel change
Merkle leaf_hash domain framing plus SHA-256 syscall over exactly 1,568 C1 bytes or 128 C2 bytes; empty-leaf control is reported
standalone gamma power-table construction with matched 816-byte serialization/hash control
q36-representative batch of 35 distinct account-backed fibers: unprepared fused setup per fiber versus one prepared gamma/weight table reused across all fibers
excluded_work: fixture generation, account creation, upload transactions, rent, and upload CU
Merkle frontier/node hashing, query derivation, proof parsing beyond the fixture account envelope, and full PCS verification
51 evaluation-claim transcript framing, LogUp/payment constraints, composition, masking/hiding, and g32 grinding
notes: SUPERSEDED: this run measured one exact fiber only. The canonical tag-21 artifact adds the collision-free q36 maximum of 36 distinct fibers and compares per-fiber setup against one prepared weight table reused across the batch.
This is an exact-width SBF diagnostic, not a proof and not the final payment-v4 KAT. ABI tag 20 remains reserved/inactive; this diagnostic is append-only tag 21.
All five simulations per mode are asserted bit-for-bit deterministic. Acceptance means the SBF sink equals the independently computed host sink.

C1 arithmetic is 49 CM31 values per slot because this diagnostic prices Aspis's current custom CM31-coset PCS; the two C2 helpers are QM31 terms weighted by gamma^49 and gamma^50. An M31 circle-polynomial PCS is a separate candidate protocol measured separately, not a reinterpretation of these bytes.
Absolute transaction CU includes compute-budget dispatch, program/account dispatch, fixture framing, and sink comparison. Use the paired/control deltas for kernel attribution.
The representative batch count is 35 because both checked-in q36/g32 v3 fixtures (binary and radix-4) encode 35 unique layer-0 fibers; 36 remains the collision-free maximum.
If the unprepared batch exhausts the transaction budget, its reported CU is a cap/failure observation and the prepared savings field is a lower bound, not an exact total delta.
The corruption matrix changes canonical C1/C2 field bytes in uploaded accounts and proves both arithmetic implementations and exact leaf hashes consume those bytes.
